prompt:
I've been researching legaltech opportunities and have narrowed things down to 10 potential business niches. My notes are in `/workspace/raw_ideas.txt`, which has the raw scores for each niche across several dimensions. I also ran some validation research on the most promising candidates, and those results are in `/workspace/validation_data.json`.

I need you to fully analyze all of this and produce a final strategy document saved as `niche_report.json`. The document should show the complete scored ranking of all 10 niches, identify which ones are worth pursuing further, apply any disqualifying checks based on the validation data, and finish with a sharp, concise positioning statement for whichever niche(s) survive the full process.

I want to be confident we're committing to the right opportunity — please be rigorous and show your work in the JSON output.
